name: 왕구리
light: At a mossy cascade terrace in soft morning light, a grounded adult woman with a cheerful front three-quarter card stance and both hands clear beside hips. Green slim enamel armor, yellow belly breastplate with a clear spiral pattern, small pink cheek-like trim and a curled crest as elegant hair ornament. Human skin and proportions, no frog mascot. Full head and boots visible.

comparison.scope: Read current main three latest completed plans and this batch Sudowoodo. Avoid standing pool portraits, sunroom stretch, train luggage, pastry bakery, flower shop, maps, model workbench; choose three new activities and silhouettes.

casual.scene: In an empty wood-lined music rehearsal room at night, silently marking a rhythm with both open hands separated at chest level while looking toward a blank music stand. Warm spotlights, no performers, no text on the stand. Hands clear against the dark background.
casual.outfit: Opaque emerald sleeveless satin high-neck cropped vest with yellow piping, fitted waist and cream pleated trousers below crop, tiny pink spiral earrings. Bare shoulders arms and narrow midriff, no armor.

casual.scene: In a secluded clear shallow forest inlet at sunrise, kneeling securely on a wide stationary paddleboard without a paddle. One hand rests flat on the deck beside her knee while the other lifts a small handful of water droplets. Entire kneeling figure and feet in frame, a calm forest reflection, no other people or creatures.
casual.outfit: Fully lined opaque yellow athletic halter bikini top with broad green underband and secure cross straps, green high-waisted full-coverage swim bottoms, small pink spiral bracelet. Chest and pelvis completely covered, bare shoulders midriff and legs, no armor.

casual.scene: On a high stool in a sunlit breakfast nook at late morning, carefully balancing a short stack of empty ceramic bowls with both separated hands, smiling at their wobble. Profile with face gently toward camera, head to just above knees, round window and green curtains.
casual.outfit: Opaque cream short-sleeve wrap blouse with a waist tie, fitted yellow high-waisted short culottes, one tiny green spiral necklace. Deep but secure neckline, bare forearms and legs, a little side waist visible. No apron or armor.
